claim_reviews.rationale: The IAA winter-1994 report documents three fragments of alternate pair-twined twig basketry, associated olive stones and clay fill; its in-situ and conserved images match Rosenberg KS 2 Fig. 7.

IAA states calibrated 5000–4730 BCE for the braiding, RT 4689. Its original lab documentation, sampled fragment, calibration and probability remain unavailable. 2013 attributes a different range to the braid; the same range is assigned to pit-8 mat RT 855 in 2017. 2023 gives a site envelope. The new date remains explicitly reported and approximate.
A reported direct date on the braiding is distinct from the dating of a separate crushed-olive installation; inferred holding and pressing are not demonstrated.

The actual 1997 Fig. 5, IAA 2007 Fig. 3 and 2023 Fig. 7a reproduce the same in-situ photograph. IAA reports separate crushed-olive installation several dozen metres south. The basket’s function and contemporaneity with a specific episode are not established.
